name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention. The trailing '27' is the chapter ID (chapters 01-30 are meaningful domain IDs), not a Ghidra address residue (the function lives at 0x33AF1, unrelated to 27). Name accurately reflects the role: per-chapter init handler for chapter 27, dispatched via the chapter init handler table (DATA xref from 0x51DD9), 0 direct callers.
purpose: Chapter 27 (命運的交會點, the GOOD/BAD ENDING fork chapter) init handler: runs a cinematic prologue of cutscene + dialog pages and three screen-wide spell visual effects, with a Sky-Key-gated bonus dialog page, before handing the chapter to the player.
logic_summary: Re-inits battle state; pans camera-and-window (9,0x31); fires cutscene 0x4C; shows dialog page 0. If fd2_any_char_has_item(100) (天空之鑰 / Sky Key) != -1, shows bonus dialog page 3. Shows dialog page 4; re-pans (9,0x31). Then three spell beats via fd2_cast_screen_wide_spell_with_fade epicentered at the live battle cursor (radius/increment 2,2): beat1 (cursor_x, cursor_y+3) then page 5; beat2 (cursor_x, cursor_y) then cutscene 0x51 + page 6; beat3 (cursor_x+2, cursor_y) then page 7 -- each beat immediately followed by fd2_set_vga_palette_range_with_add(0,0xFF,0) to restore the palette. Finally clears all facings and pans camera to char 0. Single conditional branch (the Sky-Key gate); CMP EAX,-1 consumes the genuine fd2_any_char_has_item return. Leading __CHK(0x28) is the Watcom frame-size stack-probe, not source body. In the binary the page-7 dialog + clear-facing + pan tail is a tail-JMP into the shared epilogue owned by fd2_chapter_05_init (0x3312D); the straight-line src is the Layer-2 equivalent.

returns.semantics: No return value; side-effects only (battle state init, camera pans, cutscene triggers, dialog pages, spell visual effects, palette resets, facing clear).

comment_original_issue: Source comment block was accurate and matched the decompilation, but contained non-ASCII em-dash characters (U+2014 '—') at several lines, violating the project ASCII-only-in-code rule (CJK proper nouns 命運的交會點 / 天空之鑰 / 悠妮 are allowed and retained).
